operations.text: Nominal U=lr*T/(1-m) is not a universal fit threshold. In full-batch fixed-feature half-MSE, each target-aligned curvature mode λ follows exact SGD/momentum recurrence; slow modes and momentum startup determine saturation. Adam progress also depends on parameter coordinates, so no model-independent constant SGD-to-Adam U conversion follows. Apply exact theory to fixed features only; measure Jacobian drift before using it for nonlinear capacity comparisons.
operations.evidence: 192 fixed-feature development/OOD calibration cells; known exact recurrence and coordinate dependence verified. B02/B03 separately measure nonlinear departures; no solver evaluation.

operations.text: Initial-Jacobian spectrum predicts early MLP SGD progress, not late fit or generalization. In full-batch SiLU MLPs32samples/w8,32, nonlinear feature learning beats fixed initial-Jacobian fit on8/8predeclared new-function/d5SGDunits, but test loss is worse on6/8. Capacity and learning progress therefore cannot be reduced to initial scalarU; distinguish target-directed kernel change and implicit bias before ranking generalization.
